events.description: ENDORSED ORDER denying without prejudice 5 Motion for Temporary Restraining Order. Text of Order: Plaintiff's motion for a temporary restraining order (TRO) (Doc. no. 5) is denied without prejudice. See Fed. R. Civ. P. 65(b)(1). Plaintiff, who refers to a nomination-paper signature deadline of August 5, 2026, has not shown that immediate and irreparable injury, loss, or damage will result before Defendant can be heard in opposition. The clerk's office is directed to provide an electronic copy of this Order and the motion for a TRO (Doc. no. 5) to the Civil Bureau Chief of the New Hampshire Attorney General's Office as soon as practicable. So Ordered by Judge Landya B. McCafferty.(vln)

events.description: ENDORSED ORDER. Text of Order: The clerk's office is directed to add the New Hampshire Attorney General's Office as a Notice Party to this case until otherwise ordered. The clerk's office is further directed to provide an electronic copy of the Complaint (Doc. No. 1), this Order, and the Motion for Preliminary Injunction (Doc. No. 6) to the Civil Bureau Chief of the New Hampshire Attorney General's Office as soon as practicable. The clerk's office shall schedule a case management conference early in the week of July 6, 2026. The court anticipates setting an expedited schedule on Plaintiff's motion for preliminary injunction (Doc. No. 6) in that case management conference. So Ordered by US Magistrate Judge Andrea K Johnstone.(vln)

events.description: ENDORSED ORDER Setting Hearing on 6 Motion for Preliminary Injunction. Text of Order: On or before July 9, 2026, the Secretary of State will notify the court and Mr. Day whether it will stipulate to the factual record as pleaded by Mr. Day in his complaint (Doc. No. 1). On or before July 13, 2026, the parties may file briefing on Mr. Days motion for preliminary relief (Doc. No. 6). Mr. Day may but need not file briefing in addition to the material already submitted to the court. The court will hold a hearing on the motion on July 15 at 11:00 a.m. So Ordered by US Magistrate Judge Andrea K Johnstone.(vln)

events.description: ENDORSED ORDER. Text of Order: Based on the stipulations provided by the defendant, the court understands that the NH Secretary of State is prepared to move forward on the pending motion for a preliminary injunction upon the facts set forth in doc. no. 7. in lieu of an evidentiary hearing. Mr. Day shall review the notice of stipulation and inform the court no later than 4 p.m. July 13, 2026 as to whether he agrees to move forward with the facts as stipulated in doc. no. 7 or whether he seeks an evidentiary hearing to establish facts he believes are not set forth therein. The clerk's office shall schedule a remote case management conference on July 14 if Mr. Day notifies the court that he believes an evidentiary hearing is necessary. So Ordered by US Magistrate Judge Andrea K Johnstone.(de)
